verdict.rationale: The axis applies: the IRS runs online services and machine channels where scheduled or background automation is conceivable. However, the evidence documents no user-configurable automations that run autonomously. MeF and IRIS A2A are credentialed system-to-system transmission rails, which are developer building blocks rather than product automations. EFTPS and Payment Plan appear only as titles, with no documented scheduling or recurring-execution capability, and the online flows (ID.me biometric sign-in, 15-minute session expiry) require a person to be present.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
